fields.label: Details
fields.$comment: The custom-field list. A laptop and a VPS share almost no metadata, so the per-item detail is name/value rows rather than fixed fields -- promoting one to a real field costs context tokens for every user on every read. Same nested-list shape as the `references` blocks in knowledge, projects, lifestyle and aesthetics, with `value` where those have `url`/`notes`. No alias on `name`: an alias only resolves if server.py's FIELD_ALIASES accepts it, which a declarative pack cannot add, and the parent parameter is `inventory_item_name`, so a bare `name` collides with nothing.

sections.$comment: One flat list. Grouping devices, services and homelab into separate nodes was considered and dropped: the categories blur (a homelab box is a computer and a server) and the long tail lands nowhere. `category` as a facet does the same job with one field. No purchase price, serial, warranty or acquired date -- this section is what the user has, for an agent that needs to know their kit, not an asset register; any of those goes in `specs` if a user wants it.
